q.line: And strap your hands across my engines
stanza: Wendy let me in, I wanna be your friend
I want to guard your dreams and visions
Just wrap your legs 'round these velvet rims
And strap your hands across my engines
Together we could break this trap
We'll run 'til we drop, baby we'll never go back
Oh, will you walk with me out on the wire?
'Cause baby I'm just a scared and lonely rider
But I gotta know how it feels
I want to know if love is wild, babe
I want to know if love is real
Oh, can you show me?

q.line: I swear goodwill kept up the engine
stanza: That first car was like wings on an angel (You flew away)
Before the whole wide world got too thin (From me then)
I swear goodwill kept up the engine
You were steerin' my heart like a wheel in your hands (Turn back, darling)

partner.line: Before the whole wide world got too thin (From me then)

q.line: Where the girls would shine like the engines
stanza: I remember the Burger Boy
Where the girls would shine like the engines
And the radio was always loud
When I was a boy in Ohio
Spanish teacher she tried to help
But she was much too pretty
So I just stared at the back of her legs
When I was a boy in Ohio
